subject: Request: Senior approval for >20% Hosted API concession — DataWell
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@datawell.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@datawell.ai
Date: 2028-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DataWell ask — 35% hosted-API discount for 12m commit

Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood’s latency and multi-region routing. We ran the numbers overnight and have a clear large-volume plan. To make the math work for our product roadmap, we need something in the range of a 30–35% unit-rate reduction on Hosted API usage for a 12-month committed plan (we’d prepay monthly but commit to the baseline).

Attachments: DataWell_usage_forecast_Q4-Q1.xlsx (xlsx) — forecast & assumed qps

What flexibility do you have at the executive level? We’re ready to sign once commercial terms align.

—Oliver Grant
Head of Cloud Partnerships
DataWell, Inc.
oliver@datawell.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: DataWell ask — 35% hosted-API discount for 12m commit (escalation)

Team — looping you in for quick executive consideration. DataWell (large health-data analytics customer) is requesting a 30–35% volumetric discount on Hosted API unit pricing in exchange for a 12-month committed baseline (they say prepay monthly). Key points:
• Forecast indicates steady ramp to ~4B tokens/month by month 6 (attached)
• Competitive pressure: they have a pilot offer from a hyperscaler managed endpoint at a slightly higher latency but lower list price
• Win triggers: strategic reference, multi-region onboarding, potential Dedicated conversation next year

Why I’m asking for senior approval: our standard concession band tops out at 20% without senior sign-off. Given the potential ARR and reference value, I think a deeper concession could be justified conditionally, but I want direction on guardrails.

Requested ask: executive approval to offer up to 30% off list Hosted API unit rates with conditions (12-month minimum, 60-day usage SLAs, no multi-cloud trial). If we can go to 35% I’ll require ben/finance to confirm margin fallback.

Attachments: DataWell_usage_forecast_Q4-Q1.xlsx

Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DataWell ask — 35% hosted-API discount for 12m commit (escalation)

Thanks Marcus — I reviewed the forecast and the strategic signals. Recommendation from leadership: we are willing to authorize a conditional 30% concession on Hosted API list rates for DataWell under the following binding conditions:

1) Minimum committed spend: 12 months with a baseline monthly token commitment of 1.5B tokens.
2) Payment terms: net-30 with an initial refundable commitment deposit equal to one month’s baseline.
3) Usage guardrails: cadence reviews at months 1, 3, and 6; automatic step-up pricing if usage exceeds 125% of forecasted baseline for two consecutive months.
4) No concurrent marketplace credits or partner stacking; limited to Redwood-hosted contract.
5) Legal to add a short Addendum limiting liability and confirming Redwood’s right to revert pricing after sustained abnormal burst patterns.

If Ben confirms we can accept margin at 30% at that baseline, approve and I’ll sign off. For anything >30% (i.e., 35%), we need explicit Finance sign-off and a regional director endorsement. Karthik — can you weigh in on reference vs. margin tradeoff? Ben — please confirm P&L impact at the proposed baseline ASAP.

Mina Haddad
SVP, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@datawell.ai>
Cc: procurement@datawell.ai, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataWell ask — 35% hosted-API discount for 12m commit — leadership decision

Oliver — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the detailed forecast. Leadership has reviewed and we can extend a conditional commercial concession: up to 30% off Hosted API list pricing for a 12‑month committed baseline (details below). Full sign-off is conditional on legal & finance addenda (listed).

Summary of offer (approved):
• Discount: 30% off list Hosted API per-token unit rate
• Commitment: 12 months minimum with baseline of 1.5B tokens/month
• Payment: net-30; refundable security deposit equal to one month’s baseline
• Operational: monthly usage reporting, cadence reviews at 1/3/6 months; automatic price step-up if usage surpasses 125% of baseline for two months
• Exclusions: no stacking with marketplace credits; Redwood-hosted only for initial 12 months

Next steps: I’m attaching a SOW stub and the DataWell forecast we used. If that aligns, please confirm intent to sign and I’ll loop legal to draft the addendum (expect a 48–72 hour turnaround). If you need a deeper concession (35%), we’ll need a finance margin waiver and an additional exec endorsement which will add time to approval.

Attachments: DataWell_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf); DataWell_usage_forecast_Q4-Q1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — look forward to closing quickly.

Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
